conventions.indexing: All positions are 0-indexed. The draft's 1-indexed position u (z', y, rows i' of M~, the hypercube coordinates bit(u), bit(l)) is our u - 1. Provers are numbered 1..n.
conventions.bit_strings: nat(b_1..b_s) = sum_j b_j 2^{s-j} (b_1 most significant; m0-spec). Coefficient vectors of multilinear polynomials are ordered by nat: f[nat(q)] multiplies prod_j X_j^{q_j}, X_1 <-> the most significant bit. monomials(x)[nat(b)] = prod_j x_j^{b_j} (subfield.py).
conventions.field: F_{q^k} = R_q^H in Hachi's basis (Hachi Eq. (7)); an element is (a_0..a_{k-1}); multiplication is that of R_q (subfield.py).
conventions.psi_E: psi, psi^{-1}, E exactly as ref/hachico_ref/subfield.py; E_matrix[i][j] = coefficient i of E(X^j).
conventions.gadgets: Digits balanced in [ceil(-b/2), ceil(b/2)-1]. G_{b,n} = I_n (x) (1, b, .., b^{delta-1}), element-major: entry i's digits at i*delta .. i*delta+delta-1 (digit e has weight b^e); J the same with tau digits. G^{-1}(x) decomposes rep(x) = x if x <= top else x - q, top = (ceil(b/2)-1)(b^delta-1)/(b-1) (legacy crates/hachi to_window rule). J^{-1}(z) decomposes the integer z.
conventions.blocks: f' has 2^r blocks of 2^m ring elements, f'[i*2^m + j]; block i is owned by prover (i >> (r - ceil(log n))) + 1 if that is <= n, else it is all-zero and owned by nobody.
conventions.pconv: f_hat[nat(p) 2^l + nat(q)] = <f>_{nat(p)+1}[nat(q)] for nat(p) < n, else 0; f'[t] = psi(f_hat[t*(d/k) .. t*(d/k) + d/k - 1]).
conventions.commit_state: s_i = G^{-1}_{2^m}(f'_i) (shape 2^m*delta x d), t_i = A s_i, t_hat_i = G^{-1}_{n_A}(t_i); t_hat = (t_hat_0, .., t_hat_{2^r-1}) with zero blocks for unowned i.
conventions.conv: x' = 1^{ceil(log n)} || x[0 : l-alpha+kappa]; b = monomials(x'[0:r]); a = monomials(x'[r:l']); v_point = psi(monomials(x[l-alpha+kappa : l])); d[nat(i) 2^m + nat(j)] = b_i a_j; <u>_p = sum over p's blocks of d_t f'_t; F_AH(E) outputs E(u); u itself stays shared.
conventions.z_prime_layout: z' = [w_hat (2^r delta) | w0_hat (n delta) | t0_hat (n n_A delta) | rho (n m_rho) | t_hat (2^r n_A delta) | z_hat (2^m delta tau) | <u> (1)]; z_hat entry (j*delta+e)*tau+t is digit t of z[j*delta+e].
conventions.M_rows: rows of M: D (n_D), B (n_B), b^T G (1), c^T(x)G_1 | 1_n^T(x)G_1 | -a^T G J (1), 1_n^T(x)G_{n_A} | c^T(x)G_{n_A} | -A J (n_A); y = (v, u_com, 0, 0, 0).
conventions.shares: <z'>_p equals z' on the positions S_p and 0 elsewhere, except position mu-1 (<u>), which holds <u>_p. Prover 1 holds y; the other provers hold 0. S_p: p's blocks of w_hat and t_hat, its own w0_hat, t0_hat, rho, and (p = 1) z_hat. Positions of unowned zero blocks are in no S_p.
conventions.quotient: <r>_p = 1/2 (1 - X^d)(M <z'>_p - {y}_p) mod X^{2d}+1 with entries read as degree < d polynomials; stored as 2d residues.
conventions.hypercube: V = (U, L), |U| = ell_U = ceil(log(mu+n')), |L| = ell_L = log 2d; point index nat(V) = u0 * 2d + l0 with V_1 the most significant bit. <w~>_p table: (u0 < mu, l0 < d) -> <z'>_p[u0] coefficient l0; (mu <= u0 < mu+n', any l0) -> <r>_p[u0-mu] coefficient l0; else 0.
conventions.eq: eq_table(tau)[nat(x)] = prod_j (tau_j x_j + (1-tau_j)(1-x_j)), tau_1 pairs with the most significant bit. eq(tau_0, (U, L, bit(i))) uses tau_0[0:ell_pp] for (U, L) and tau_0[ell_pp:] for the ceil(log n) bits of i-1. eq(tau_1, bit(i')) is eq_table(tau_1)[i'-1].
conventions.M_tilde: M*(u0, l0) = sum_{i'} eq(tau_1, bit(i')) M~_alpha(bit(i'), u0, l0): (u0 < mu) c_u alpha^{l0} for all l0 < 2d with c_u = sum_{i0 < n'} eq1[i0] M[i0][u0](alpha); (mu <= u0 < mu+n') -eq1[u0-mu] (alpha^d + 1) alpha^{l0}; plus at u0 = mu-1, l0 < d: sum_{j0<d} eq1[n'+j0] E[j0][l0]; plus for u0 < mu+n', l0 >= d: eq1[n' + d + u0 + (l0-d)(mu+n')].
conventions.F0: F_{0,p} = eq(tau_0,(U,L,bit(p))) [ e_p prod_{c=-b+1}^{b-1} (<w~>_p - c) + (1 - e_p - ind) <w~>_p ], e_p = indicator of S_p (rows), ind = indicator of rows mu-1 .. mu+n'-1 (the draft's mu .. mu+n').
conventions.rounds: round r binds V_r; messages are H_{0,r}(t) for t = 1..d0+1 and H_{1,r}(t) for t = 1..d1+1 (the F_AH(I) outputs); V interpolates H(0) and H(a_r).
conventions.blinders: g(V) = s0 + sum_{j=1}^{ell_pp} sum_{k=1}^{D} s[j-1][k-1] V_j^k, D = d0 for g0 and d1 for g1.
conventions.challenges: c_i uniform in {c : ||c||_1 <= omega} (exact sampler, prg.py); alpha, rho, tau0, tau1, a_r uniform in F_{q^k}; all verifier coins come from the instance seed (public coins).
conventions.retries: An abort ends Eval with (bot, bot); the caller restarts it. Pi_conv is deterministic, so the oracle re-runs only the ring-to-linear step with fresh masks, rho and c (attempt index).
conventions.base_pcs: Deferred: commitments are not modelled; openings are checked by evaluating the committed polynomials directly (IdealPCS).

seeds.prg: SHAKE128 counter mode with domain separation, ref/hachico_ref/prg.py

selection.rule: smallest index s >= 0 whose run has an aborted ring-to-linear attempt (retry-path coverage)
